title: ADR-0012 契约先行：Skin 0.1.0-alpha.1 匿名窗口五缺口（预览/详情/下载/删除）
objective: 按 Foundation ADR-0012（所有者 2026-10-07 W10 方案 A：不可猜测 UUID + 匿名窗口）把 skin.yaml 从 0.1.0-draft 升为 0.1.0-alpha.1：补齐候选预览字节、会话详情+消息、成品下载、会话删除四个匿名操作，顶层安全改为匿名（userOAuth 保留为 Official 模式文档性方案），并机器锁定匿名窗口保留期语义（30d 会话/24h 候选）；Skin 生产者实现属后续 Skin 线切片，本切片不改 Core/Ops/Skin 任何文件。
in_scope: openapi/skin.yaml 升至 0.1.0-alpha.1：新增 GET /v1/conversations/{conversationId}（getConversation，返回含 messages 的会话详情）、DELETE /v1/conversations/{conversationId}（deleteConversation，级联候选与产物，204）、GET /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/candidates/{candidateId}/preview（getCandidatePreview，PNG 字节）、GET /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/skins/{resourceId}/download（downloadSkin，PNG 字节）
顶层 security 改为匿名（security: []），userOAuth 保留为 Official 模式文档性方案（ADR-0012）；每操作描述声明不可枚举 UUID、30d 会话/24h 候选保留期与 404 语义
docs/api-catalog.md Skin 段、docs/compatibility.md Skin 0.1.0-alpha.1 行、docs/STATUS.md、docs/development-plan.md 同步
out_of_scope: Skin 生产者实现（后续 Skin 线切片）；userOAuth 实际启用；会话 Bearer 凭据（ADR-0012 拒绝）；消息分页/批量资料查询/积分消费回退
修改 core.yaml/community.yaml/事件信封/既有 alpha 锁定语义；修改 Core、Ops、Skin、Community、Foundation 任何文件；MCP-F1-SKIN-008 与 MCP-F1-CORE-008 一切不变
contract_impact: additive prerelease: skin.yaml 0.1.0-draft -> 0.1.0-alpha.1 adds four anonymous operations (getConversation, deleteConversation, getCandidatePreview, downloadSkin) under the ADR-0012 anonymous-window semantics; the existing four draft operations keep their shapes; core.yaml, community.yaml and all locked schemas stay untouched
acceptance_evidence: validate_contracts.py 通过（20+ schemas、4 OpenAPI 文档、新 operationIds 唯一、每操作显式 4xx）；redocly lint 三+一文档 exit 0
兼容矩阵登记 Skin 0.1.0-alpha.1 行（生产者未实现，Skin 线切片按 ADR-0012 匿名窗口语义跟进）

validation_results: Registered 2026-10-07T13:16:47.991Z from live state: Contracts main 8350c3d clean and synced; Contracts lock free inside the critical section; prerequisite ADR-0012 verified present on Foundation main (owner W10 option-A decision 2026-10-07); concurrent active workstreams (MCP-F1-CORE-008 Core+Ops, MCP-F1-SKIN-008 Skin-only blocked) verified disjoint from this write-set.

Final acceptance on the committed tree: validate_contracts.py passed (20 JSON schemas/events, 3 OpenAPI documents, 30 unique operationIds) in the pinned python 3.12 venv; redocly lint exit 0 across all OpenAPI documents (one expected no-unused-components warning: the userOAuth security scheme is intentionally unreferenced under the ADR-0012 anonymous-window semantics and stays as Official-mode documentation); docs updated (api-catalog Skin section, compatibility classification + matrix row, STATUS, development-plan).

Alpha.1 semantics delivered exactly as scoped per ADR-0012 option A: four anonymous operations (getConversation detail+messages, deleteConversation with cascade, getCandidatePreview PNG bytes, downloadSkin PNG bytes) on top of the unchanged four draft operations; unguessable 128-bit UUID addressing, 30d conversation / 24h candidate retention documented per operation, explicit 404 for unknown/expired/deleted, no credential object model, userOAuth retained as Official-mode documentation (its no-unused-components warning is intentional). Skin producer implementation belongs to a later Skin-line slice (SKIN-008 owner, after the Q-001=B decision is exercised with the owner-deposited paid key).
